task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

calls.candidate: hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), hard RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box)
calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the second clause uses RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box), but the task says the box must be in the agent's hands at the exit ('If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box'). RespondedExistence is satisfied by holding_box at any earlier time, so an agent could carry the box early, put it down, and still exit empty-handed without breaking the clause. Replace it with the hard Response(at_exit, holding_box): reaching the exit is only the condition of an 'if' (no Existence(at_exit)), and since at_exit is true only on the final step, Response requires holding_box on that step, exactly what the task demands. The ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) clause is correct: 'each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move' needs the very-next-step timing.
